questions.question: India’s first Ocean Thermal Energy Conversion (OTEC)-powered desalination plant is being established at which location?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Kavaratti.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Union Minister Dr. Jitendra Singh reviewed the progress of India’s first OTEC-powered desalination facility in Kavaratti, Lakshadweep.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Technology:** The plant uses **Ocean Thermal Energy Conversion (OTEC)** to simultaneously generate electricity and 100 cubic metres of potable water per day without fossil fuels.
 
• **Mechanism:** It utilizes the temperature gradient between warm surface water and cold deep-sea water (drawn from over 1,000 metres depth).
 
• **Infrastructure:** A 3.8 km long high-density polyethylene (HDPE) pipeline is being installed for the project.
 
• **Agency:** The project is being implemented by the **National Institute of Ocean Technology (NIOT)** under the Ministry of Earth Sciences.
 
• **Impact:** It aims to provide water and energy security to the island, reducing its heavy reliance on diesel-based power.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• OTEC (Ocean Thermal Energy Conversion)__

 __
 
• A process that can produce electricity by using the temperature difference between deep cold ocean water and warm tropical surface waters.
 
 
 
• NIOT__
 __
 
• The National Institute of Ocean Technology, established in 1993 in Chennai, is an autonomous society under the Ministry of Earth Sciences.
 
 
 
• LTTD (Low Temperature Thermal Desalination)__
 
 
• A process where warm surface seawater is evaporated under low pressure and the vapor is condensed using cold deep-sea water to produce fresh water.

questions.question: Which indigenous Project 17A class stealth frigate is the Indian Navy set to commission on 03 April 2026 at Visakhapatnam?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**INS Taragiri.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Indian Navy will commission its fourth Project 17A stealth frigate, Taragiri (F41), in Visakhapatnam on 03 April 2026.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Class & Project:** Taragiri belongs to the **Project 17A (Nilgiri-class)**, which are follow-ons to the Shivalik-class frigates with improved stealth features.
 
• **Manufacturer:** It was built by **Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders Limited (MDL)**, Mumbai, with over **75% indigenous content**.

• **Stealth:** Designed with a reduced Radar Cross-Section (RCS) to make it harder to detect by enemy sensors.
 
• **Armament:** Equipped with supersonic surface-to-surface missiles, Medium Range Surface-to-Air Missiles (MRSAM), and advanced anti-submarine warfare (ASW) suites.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Project 17A__**

__

• Under Project 17A, a total of seven ships were ordered (4 at MDL and 3 at GRSE). These ships are named after hill ranges in India: Nilgiri, Himgiri, Taragiri, Udaygiri, Dunagiri, Vindhyagiri, and Mahendragiri.

questions.question: Which organization has successfully tested India’s first indigenously developed Floating LiDAR Buoy System in Tamil Nadu?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**National Institute of Ocean Technology (NIOT).**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The National Institute of Ocean Technology (NIOT) has successfully tested India's first indigenous Floating LiDAR (Light Detection and Ranging) Buoy System.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Testing Site:** The system was deployed off the **Muttom coast in Tamil Nadu**.
 
• **Technology:** It uses **laser pulses** to measure wind speed, direction, and turbulence at heights up to **300 meters** above sea level.
 
• **Strategic Goal:** This supports India's **70 GW offshore wind potential** target, specifically for the coasts of Gujarat and Tamil Nadu.
 
• **Indigenisation:** Developed under **Atmanirbhar Bharat**, reducing procurement costs by **30-40%** compared to European imports.
 
• **Resilience:** The buoy is engineered to withstand **monsoonal cyclones** and high humidity in the Indian Ocean.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **About NIOT__**

__
 
• National Institute of Ocean Technology__

 
 
• NIOT is an autonomous body under the **Ministry of Earth Sciences**, Government of India. It was established in 1993 and is headquartered in **Chennai**.

questions.question: In which state was the Indian Army's Southern Command exercise, 'Amogh Jwala', conducted in March 2026?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Uttar Pradesh.**__

__
 
• **The Southern Command of the Indian Army conducted 'Exercise Amogh Jwala' at the Babina Field Firing Ranges in Uttar Pradesh from 6 to 18 March 2026.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

questions.question: Which village is set to become Odisha’s first "Smart Village" under a CSIR initiative?
questions.solution:

__
 
• **Kusunpur, a village in the Kendrapada district of Odisha, has been selected to become the state’s first "smart village" as part of the "Viksit Bharat@2047" national vision.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The project will implement advanced systems for clean drinking water, renewable energy, and modern sanitation for approximately 130 families in Kusunpur.**
 
• Given the region's vulnerability to cyclones, the plan includes building climate-resilient schools, Anganwadi centres, and multipurpose shelters.
 
• Multiple Council of Scientific and Industrial Research (CSIR) laboratories are coordinating to provide technological solutions for rural self-reliance and skill training in sectors like textiles and leather products.
 
• Odisha__
 __
 
• Capital - Bhubaneswar
 
• Chief Minister - Mohan Charan Majhi
 
• Governor - Raghubar Das
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• Viksit Bharat@2047__
 __
 
• Overview: It is the Government of India's vision to transform India into a developed nation by the 100th year of its independence in 2047, focusing on economic growth, environmental sustainability, and social progress.
 
 
 
• Smart Village Initiative__
 
 
• Overview: A developmental model aimed at transforming rural areas into self-reliant communities by combining traditional community participation with cutting-edge science and modern infrastructure.

questions.question: What is the theme for the 8th Jan Aushadhi Diwas, celebrated on March 7, 2026?

options.text: Jan Aushadhi – Sehat Bhi, Suvidha Bhi
Jan Aushadhi Sasti Bhi, Bharosemand Bhi
Jan Aushadhi – Sasta Nahin, Sabse Accha

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Jan Aushadhi Sasti Bhi, Bharosemand Bhi – Sehat ki Baat, Bachat ke Saath.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The 8th Jan Aushadhi Diwas was observed on 7 March 2026, marking the culmination of a week-long awareness campaign.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The theme for 2026 is “Jan Aushadhi Sasti Bhi, Bharosemand Bhi – Sehat ki Baat, Bachat ke Saath” (Jan Aushadhi is inexpensive and reliable; it protects health and helps with savings).**
 
• **The day concludes the 'Janaushadhi Saptah' (1–7 March 2026), an outreach initiative to promote affordable and quality generic medicines.**
 
• **Jan Aushadhi medicines are priced 50% to 90% lower than branded equivalents while maintaining the same quality standards.**
 
• **The initiative is spearheaded by the Pharmaceuticals and Medical Devices Bureau of India (PMBI) under the Department of Pharmaceuticals.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• PMBJP__

 __
 
• Pradhan Mantri Bhartiya Janaushadhi Pariyojana, launched in 2008 to provide quality generic medicines at affordable prices.
 
 
 
• Janaushadhi Kendra__
 __
 
• Specialized outlets that sell generic medicines under the PMBJP scheme; the government aims to open 25,000 such kendras across India.
 
 
 
• Generic Medicines__
 __
 
• Medicines that are equivalent to brand-name drugs in dosage, safety, strength, quality, and performance but are sold under their chemical names.
 
 
 
• Jan Aushadhi Sugam App__
 
 
• A mobile application that helps citizens locate the nearest Janaushadhi Kendra and check medicine availability/pricing.

questions.question: Following the resignation of Pieter Elbers in March 2026, who has taken over as the interim CEO of IndiGo?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Rahul Bhatia.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **IndiGo CEO Pieter Elbers resigned with immediate effect on March 10, 2026, and Founder Rahul Bhatia has assumed the role of interim CEO.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Leadership Change:** Rahul Bhatia, the **Managing Director and Founder** of InterGlobe Aviation (IndiGo), took over the top executive role to stabilize the airline.
 
• **Reason for Resignation:** Pieter Elbers stepped down following a major **operational collapse in December 2025**, which saw over 5,000 flight cancellations.
 
• **Crisis Factor:** The disruption was largely attributed to **crew shortages** linked to the implementation of new **Flight Duty Time Limitations (FDTL)** rules.
 
• **Regulatory Impact:** The incident led to significant scrutiny from the **Directorate General of Civil Aviation (DGCA)** regarding the airline's operational management.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• IndiGo (InterGlobe Aviation Ltd)__

 __
 
• Founded in - 2006
 
• Headquarters - Gurgaon, Haryana
 
• It is India's largest passenger airline by market share.
 
 
 
• Flight Duty Time Limitations (FDTL)__
 __
 
• Regulations set by the DGCA to ensure pilots and cabin crew get adequate rest to prevent fatigue-related safety risks.
 
 
 
• DGCA (Directorate General of Civil Aviation)__
 
 
• The statutory body of the Government of India to regulate civil aviation in India. It primarily deals with safety issues.

questions.question: Which state has launched the 'e-Swasthya Dham' portal for real-time health monitoring of pilgrims during the Char Dham Yatra?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Uttarakhand.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Uttarakhand Government has implemented an extensive medical infrastructure and digital monitoring system for the safety of Char Dham Yatra pilgrims.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Digital Initiative:** The **e-Swasthya Dham Portal** has been launched to enable real-time health monitoring and immediate medical intervention for devotees.
 
• **Emergency Transport:** A fleet of **177 ambulances** (including ALS and Cardiac units), a **boat ambulance** in Tehri, and a **helicopter ambulance** (via AIIMS Rishikesh) have been deployed.
 
• **Medical Facilities:** The government has set up **25 medical relief posts** and **33 health screening centers** along the pilgrimage routes.
 
• **Manpower:** A rotational roster of specialist doctors, medical officers, and paramedical staff, supported by 100 trained volunteers, ensures 24/7 care.
 
• **Strategic Deployment:** Medical units are stationed at all four Dhams (Yamunotri, Gangotri, Kedarnath, and Badrinath) to handle high-altitude health issues.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Char Dham Yatra__

 
 
• The pilgrimage covers four holy sites in the Himalayas: **Yamunotri, Gangotri, Kedarnath, and Badrinath**. Due to the high altitude and rugged terrain, health screening is mandatory for pilgrims to prevent altitude sickness and cardiac emergencies.

questions.question: Which new regulatory body has been constituted by the Government of India in March 2026 to replace the Dental Council of India (DCI)?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**National Dental Commission (NDC).**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Government of India officially constituted the National Dental Commission (NDC) on 19 March 2026, replacing the Dental Council of India (DCI).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Legislative Change:** The move follows the repeal of the **Dentists Act, 1948**, and the enactment of the National Dental Commission Act.
 
• **Leadership:** **Dr. Sanjay Tewari** has been appointed as the first Chairperson of the National Dental Commission.
 
• **Autonomous Boards:** The NDC features three boards: **UG & PG Dental Education Board**, **Dental Assessment and Rating Board**, and **Ethics and Dental Registration Board**.
 
• **Objectives:** The commission aims to enhance **transparency**, regulate fees in private colleges, and align dental education with global standards.
 
• **Structure:** It replaces the previous elected regulatory system with a merit-based, accountable framework for professional conduct and institutional accreditation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Similar Reforms__**

__
 
• Medical Education Evolution__

 
 
• The creation of the NDC follows a similar pattern to the establishment of the National Medical Commission (NMC), which replaced the Medical Council of India (MCI) in 2020 to reform general medical education in India.

questions.question: Who won the META Lifetime Achievement Award 2026 for his significant contribution to Indian theatre and cinema?

__
 
• **Veteran actor and director Amol Palekar won the META Lifetime Achievement Award 2026 to recognize his significant contributions to Indian theatre and cinema.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Award Ceremony:** The award was presented during the **21st edition** of the Mahindra Excellence in Theatre Awards (META), held in New Delhi from March 19 to 25, 2026.
 
• **Acting Legacy:** Amol Palekar is renowned for his **"middle-class hero"** persona and realistic acting in iconic 1970s films such as Rajnigandha, Chhoti Si Baat, and Gol Maal.
 
• **Directorial Work:** As a filmmaker, he has explored socially relevant and unconventional themes in movies like **Ankahee and Paheli** (which was India's official entry to the Oscars).

__
 
• Mahindra Excellence in Theatre Awards (META)__

 __
 
• Instituted by the **Mahindra Group** and produced by **Teamwork Arts**, META is one of India’s most prestigious theatre awards, aiming to provide a platform for stage productions from across the country.
 
 
 
• Lifetime Achievement Award__
 
 
• This category honors individuals who have dedicated their lives to the enrichment of Indian theatre. Past recipients include legends like Zohra Sehgal, Badal Sircar, and Girish Karnad.

questions.question: According to the Fitch Ratings' Global Economic Outlook (March 2026), what is the revised GDP growth estimate for India for FY26?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**7.5 percent.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Fitch Ratings has raised India's Gross Domestic Product (GDP) growth forecast for the current fiscal year (FY26) to 7.5 percent.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Revised Estimates:** Fitch increased the FY26 growth forecast from **7.4% to 7.5%** and the FY27 forecast from **6.4% to 6.7%**.
 
• **Global Context:** The agency projected world GDP growth at **2.6 percent** for 2026 in its March report.
 
• **Inflationary Pressure:** Growth is expected to moderate in the first half of FY27 as rising inflation may constrain real incomes and consumer spending.
 
• **Oil Price Sensitivity:** The forecast assumes an average oil price of **USD 70 per barrel**; a spike to USD 100 could act as a significant global supply shock.
 
• **Quarterly Trend:** The growth for the December quarter was recorded at **7.8 percent**, a slight slowdown from 8.4 percent in the September quarter.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Fitch Ratings__

 
 
• Fitch is one of the "Big Three" credit rating agencies in the world (alongside Moody's and S&P). Its ratings and economic outlooks are used by investors to assess the creditworthiness and economic health of nations and corporations.

questions.question: In the acronym AVATAAR, India's first air-and-underwater drone, what does the letter 'T' stand for?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Tactical.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **India has introduced 'AVATAAR', its first drone capable of both flying in the air and diving underwater for multi-domain operations.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Full Form:** AVATAAR stands for **Amphibious Vehicle for Autonomous Tactical Aerial & Aquatic Reconnaissance**.
 
• **Developer:** It is developed by **AquaAirX Autonomous Systems**.
 
• **Design:** Built with a **carbon-fiber structure**, it is lightweight for flight and highly resistant to corrosion for underwater missions.
 
• **Technology:** It uses **multibeam imaging sonar** for seabed mapping and an **acoustic communication modem** for underwater data transmission.
 
• **Applications:** Designed for surveillance, threat detection in ports/harbors, and real-time intelligence gathering in coastal areas.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Amphibious Capability__

 __
 
• Most drones are limited to a single medium (air or water). AVATAAR bridges this gap, allowing it to transition from aerial scouting to underwater inspection seamlessly.
 
 
 
• Global Context__
 __
 
• The article mentions that other nations are also innovating in this space, such as Ukraine’s **Toloka** underwater drone, highlighting the growing global focus on maritime autonomous systems.
 
 
 
• Maintenance__
 
 
• Due to saltwater exposure, the drone requires a **freshwater rinse** after every mission to prevent salt deposits and ensure long-term performance.

questions.question: Who won the 2026 Formula 1 season-opening Australian Grand Prix held at Albert Park on March 8, 2026?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**George Russell.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **George Russell secured a victory for Mercedes at the 2026 Australian Grand Prix, marking a dominant start to the F1 season.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dominant Finish:** Russell led a **1-2 finish** for Mercedes, with his teammate Kimi Antonelli finishing in second place.
 
• **Race Highlights:** Despite briefly losing the lead to Charles Leclerc, Russell regained it following a **Ferrari strategy error** during a Virtual Safety Car period.
 
• **Notable Debuts:** **Lewis Hamilton** finished 4th in his debut race for Ferrari, while rookie **Arvid Lindblad** secured points by finishing 8th.
 
• **Champion's Recovery:** Defending champion **Max Verstappen** made a significant comeback, moving from 20th on the grid to finish 6th.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• Kimi Antonelli__
 __
 
• The young Mercedes driver made an impressive start to his full-time F1 career by securing the 2nd podium spot in the season opener.
 
 
 
• Mercedes' Performance__
 
 
• The 2026 season features new technical regulations; Mercedes' "scintillating pace" at the opener suggests they have adapted well to the changes.

questions.question: Which ship was formally flagged into Mumbai Harbour on 2 March 2026, following its historic maiden voyage to Oman?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**INSV Kaundinya.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Shri Sanjay Seth, Raksha Rajya Mantri, flagged in the **Indian Naval Sailing Vessel (INSV) Kaundinya** at Mumbai Harbour on 2 March 2026.
 
• The ceremony marked the completion of the vessel's **maiden overseas voyage** to the Sultanate of Oman and its successful return passage across the Arabian Sea.
 
• The voyage re-traced ancient maritime trade routes, strengthening the "Sagar" (Security and Growth for All in the Region) vision and India-Oman ties.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Features__**

__
 
• **Construction:** It is a **stitched ship**, built using ancient Indian shipbuilding techniques revived from depictions in the **Ajanta Caves** (approx. 5th century).
 
• **Technique:** Unlike modern ships that use nails or welding, stitched ships use **coir ropes** to join wooden planks, treated with traditional resins and oils for waterproofing.
 
• **Collaborative Effort:** The project is a joint initiative of the **Indian Navy** and the **Ministry of Culture** to preserve Indic maritime knowledge systems.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Significance__**

 
• **Atmanirbhar Bharat:** The vessel highlights indigenous craftsmanship and the revival of lost traditional technologies.
 
• **Maritime Heritage:** INSV Kaundinya serves as a living museum of India's seafaring legacy that once dominated the Indian Ocean trade.
 
• **Crew:** The vessel was manned by a dedicated crew of Indian Navy personnel who navigated using traditional and modern methods.

questions.question: What is the official United Nations theme for International Women’s Day 2026, observed globally on March 8?

options.text: Rights. Justice. Action. For ALL Women and Girls.
DigitALL: Innovation and technology for gender equality
Gender equality today for a sustainable tomorrow

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Rights. Justice. Action. For ALL Women and Girls.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **International Women’s Day is celebrated annually on March 8 to honor the achievements and contributions of women.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The theme for 2026 is "Rights. Justice. Action. For ALL Women and Girls," focusing on systemic change and accountability.**
 
• **The 2026 campaign slogan is "Give To Gain," emphasizing the multiplier effect of mentoring and resource-sharing.**
 
• **The date March 8 traces back to a 1917 strike by Russian women textile workers for "Bread and Peace."**
 
• **The United Nations officially recognized the day in 1977 following resolution 32/142.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Clara Zetkin__

 __
 
• A German socialist who proposed the idea of an International Women's Day at the 1910 International Conference of Working Women.
 
 
 
• Suffrage Movement__
 __
 
• The historical struggle for women's right to vote, which was a core demand during the early NYC marches in 1908.
 
 
 
• UN Women__
 
 
• The United Nations entity dedicated to gender equality and the empowerment of women, which leads the global coordination of the day.

questions.question: Who was honored with the MP Birla Memorial Award 2025 for pioneering work in Radio Astronomy?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Prof. Yashwant Gupta.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Prof. Yashwant Gupta was conferred with the MP Birla Memorial Award 2025 at a ceremony held at the MP Birla Planetarium on 13th March.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Designation:** Prof. Gupta is the Distinguished Professor and Centre Director at the **National Centre for Radio Astrophysics (NCRA-TIFR)**, Pune.
 
• **Core Contribution:** He was recognized for his pioneering research in **Radio Astronomy** and his leadership in national scientific initiatives.
 
• **The Award:** Instituted in 1993, this biennial award honors excellence in **Astronomy, Astrophysics, and Space Sciences**.
 
• **Ceremony Highlights:** The award includes a citation, trophy, cash prize, and a memorial lecture delivered by the recipient.
 
• **Significance:** The MP Birla Planetarium presents this honor to eminent Indian scientists who have made world-class contributions to space science.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• NCRA-TIFR__

 __
 
• The National Centre for Radio Astrophysics is located in Pune and operates the **Giant Metrewave Radio Telescope (GMRT)**, one of the world's largest radio telescopes.
 
 
 
• Radio Astronomy__
 
 
• A subfield of astronomy that studies celestial objects at radio frequencies, allowing scientists to observe phenomena invisible to optical telescopes.

questions.question: ________ has officially become a signatory to the United Nations Global Compact (UNGC), the world’s largest corporate sustainability initiative.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**L&T Finance Ltd.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **L&T Finance Ltd. (LTF) has officially joined the United Nations Global Compact (UNGC) as a signatory.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **L&T Finance is a leading Non-Banking Financial Company (NBFC) in India.**
 
• By joining the UNGC, LTF commits to integrating **Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG)** principles into its core business strategy.
 
• The company reaffirms its commitment to the UNGC’s **Ten Principles**, which cover Human Rights, Labour, Environment, and Anti-Corruption.
 
• As a participant, LTF is required to submit an annual **Communication on Progress (CoP)** report to maintain transparency.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• United Nations Global Compact (UNGC)__

 __
 
• Launched in 2000, it is a non-binding United Nations pact to get businesses and firms worldwide to adopt sustainable and socially responsible policies.
 
 
 
• ESG Principles__
 __
 
• Environmental, Social, and Governance criteria are a set of standards for a company’s operations that socially conscious investors use to screen potential investments.
 
 
 
• Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs)__
 
 
• A collection of 17 interlinked global goals designed to be a "blueprint to achieve a better and more sustainable future for all" by 2030.

questions.question: Which roadmap was released by Rajnath Singh in March 2026 to transform the Indian Military into a future-ready force by 2047?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Defence Forces Vision 2047.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **On March 10, 2026, Raksha Mantri Shri Rajnath Singh released the document titled ‘Defence Forces Vision 2047: A Roadmap for a Future-Ready Indian Military’.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Modernization:** The roadmap focuses on transforming the military into an integrated, **multi-domain** (land, air, sea, space, and cyber), and agile force.
 
• **Jointness:** A central pillar is the emphasis on synergy among the **Army, Navy, and Air Force** for coordinated planning and operations.
 
• **Aatmanirbharta:** High priority is given to achieving self-reliance through **indigenous technologies** to reduce foreign dependency.
 
• **Timeline:** The document, articulated by **Headquarters Integrated Defence Staff**, outlines phased goals across short-term, mid-term, and long-term horizons.
 
• **Viksit Bharat:** This vision aligns with the national goal of making India a developed nation by the centenary of its independence in **2047**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Integrated Defence Staff (IDS)__

 __
 
• Established in 2001, IDS is responsible for ensuring "Jointness" among the three services and prepared this vision document.
 
 
 
• Joint Theatre Commands__
 
 
• The Vision 2047 document is a critical step toward the creation of theaterized commands to optimize resources during conflicts.
